notes.title: The Dreamatorium 2: Released!
notes.content:
The Dreamatorium 2 has been released today, on 9/9/2015 at 9AM, CET, with 10% off to celebrate the premiere. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/393150

Don't forget that promotion will last one week!

Cheers!

notes.title: The Dreamatorium 2 on Steam!
notes.content:
The Dreamatorium of Dr. Magnus was first released on 9/9/2012. 

Now, on the same day three years later, the second chapter of the game you loved comes to Steam!

The Dreamatorium of Dr. Magnus 2 will be available on September 9th, with 10% off to celebrate the premiere. 

The promotion will last one week.
